note: Assessed only. Nothing here is built, per s.H.

motion.needs: pre-snap frame SEQUENCE, not one frame; lateral speed is already computed for the abstention rule
motion.why: motion is a property of the frames this module already scans to find the last stable one

route_participation.needs: POST-snap frames plus a release/route criterion (downfield displacement vs staying in the pocket)
route_participation.why: route vs protect is separable by post-snap trajectory, but FTN-S1 measured route participation as worth ~0.6% -- so this is the LEAST valuable expansion despite being technically feasible

pass_protection_release.needs: post-snap frames plus proximity to rushers
pass_protection_release.why: the complement of route participation; same caveat on value

matchup_proximity.needs: defensive coordinates in the same frames plus a nearest-defender rule over time
matchup_proximity.why: nearest-defender is a distance computation on data the same frames already carry; it approximates FTN matchup, whose value FTN-S2 could not resolve

ordering_implied: motion and matchup_proximity are the cheap expansions; route participation is technically feasible and empirically the least valuable of the four.
